name: Imri
title: Israelite patriarch
summary: Imri is a biblical figure mentioned in the genealogies of 1 Chronicles and the book of Nehemiah. He is known as the father of Zakkur and as part of the tribe of Judah. His descendants participated in rebuilding the walls of Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Judah
keyEvents.description: Imri is mentioned as a son of Bani in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Father of Zakkur
keyEvents.description: Imri is the father of Zakkur, who took part in rebuilding Jerusalem's wall under Nehemiah's leadership.

keyEvents.title: Role of descendants in the rebuilding
keyEvents.description: Zakkur, son of Imri, was among those who built a section of Jerusalem's wall after the exile, showing the family's commitment to God's people.

keyEvents.title: Part of the returning community
keyEvents.description: The lineage of Imri was part of the Jewish community that returned from Babylon and reestablished itself in Jerusalem.
